_provenance.supersedes: The 2026-08-11..15 registry built on the FIELDWISE Master Draft (ELTE-hosted configuration). The prior registry is preserved on branch fieldwise-run-01. The host switch (ELTE→ATK), the Krumatic accession, the unnamed commercial-farmer validation site and the MVCRI move to a post-MSCA route are the operator decisions of 2026-08-26/28.
_provenance.why_this_file_exists: phase_03_gate predicate g04_p07 (all_partners_in_tier3) requires every partner assigned as a lead or contributor in wp_structure.json to exist in this file. The registry is derived from roles.json and introduces no entity, name, country or role that is not already in roles.json.
_provenance.instrument_note: MSCA-PF is a single-fellow, single-beneficiary action, not a consortium. 'Partner' here means an identifier the work-package structure references, not a consortium beneficiary. Only HOST is a beneficiary legal entity. VALIDATION_SITE is a collaborating validation environment, deliberately not a beneficiary or associated partner (Pack §3.2).
_provenance.evidence_regime: Operator ruling of 2026-08-28 (baseline record): registry-verifiable and partner-authored factual content is Confirmed against the committed sources; forward-looking commitments not yet in partner writing are operator-declared Assumed with declarations in working_assumptions.json. Nothing is Unresolved.
_provenance.token_coverage: Pack §3.1 WP lines name: WP1 'HUN-REN + MATE + ELTE' (HOST, DATA_PARTNER, EO_PARTNER); WP2 'HUN-REN + ELTE + MATE'; WP3 'Fellow + farmer + MATE + ELTE + HUN-REN' (VALIDATION_SITE added); WP4 'Fellow + Krumatic + AgroVIR consultation + HUN-REN' (SOFTWARE_PARTNER, VALIDATION_PARTNER); WP5 'Fellow + AgroVIR'. TRANSFER_PARTNER (MVCRI) sits on no WP line — it is a post-MSCA route kept for narrative traceability (Pack §3.2, Appendix B).
